title: London Bridge at Lake Havasu has children walled up in it

tellings.quote: >> Knight of Columbus is the controlling interest and the reason they brought that bridge is because there's kids walled up in it

plain: The old London Bridge, bought and rebuilt in Lake Havasu, Arizona, in the 1960s, is said to have children walled up inside it, and the Knights of Columbus, a Catholic fraternal group, are said to hold the controlling interest and to be the reason the bridge was brought over. The guest Kurt Metzger tells Michels this, repeating what a man named Nathan Reynolds told him, as part of a conversation about a secret ritual elite.
